course: The content of this course is very authentic. However, for ELT graduates most topics overlap with undergraduate material, which at times feels like repetition and at times like consolidation.

The course was well prepared, including lots of discussions, presentations, brainstorming. 
Maybe content can be enlarged with providing certain gaps in ESL research field. Potential topics or experiments can be provided as well to trigger further study environment.

The course is all about theories and it is not easy to grasp them all. They still remain vague for me. I cannot be sure if I really understand them thoroughly enough. On the other hand, every language teacher should be knowledgeable about them.

instructor: She is knowledgeable and ready to support and help her students when needed. She is understanding, and she knows what she is doing.
Her knowledge of the course content and enthusiasm to teach it are her strong points. No weak points
course: The course book was good in the sense that it introduced many theories, but it was hard to follow at the beginning especially.

It is quite a challenging course if you lack the foundation regarding the subject - SLA. It requires a lot of reading before classes. However, it is really up-to-date as the instructor designed it that way, which creates interest in the subject matters covered in the course. Taking the course from Hilal hoca made it easier for me to understand the subjects. 
More readings can be assigned to the students to make the subjects more understandable for the ones taking such a course for the first time.

instructor: She has been very successful in delivering online classes and making every point clear in the course content. The rubrics and syllabus were very clearly stated and explained at the beginning of the term. I have not felt any lost in her classes. With her effective guidance and welcoming attitude, I have learned a lot.
Her enthusiasm to teach, being understanding, caring for individual students, her knowledge of the course content, clear rubrics, and well-prepared ppts are her strong points. No weak points

The instructor has always been there to help and guide us whenever we've needed it. She has always made sure we have understood what has been covered in the classes and always supported us when required. She has been willing to answer our questions.
course: The course has met the needs of the basics of Language Testing and further. We have covered skills and language systems and analyzed questions related to these skills and language systems along with some there alternative testing. It has been quite fruitful.

instructor: She is the best in research! I feel lucky to have taken this course from her as she has always been very helpful and informative about every step that is conducted while doing research. Every single detail about the research process was made clear and she has always had a welcoming attitude towards us.

I think I am going to talk about the strongest part of hers. She invests too much energy and sacrifice into her classes. She performs incredibly well about giving timely feedback, understanding master students' needs, and checking upon students. She is the embodiment of success and hard work.

Hilal hoca has always been interested in our development as a researcher and she is quite knowledgeable in the field. Whenever you ask a question about research and anything related to research, she has been quite responsive and helpful. She is smart, appreciative, supportive, and understanding.
course: The course pushes students further to write thesis related chapters in a tight schedule, which might be challenging or satisfying to different individuals.

This course has contributed a lot in my research knowledge; I can see how much I have improved since day one.  I have felt secure taking this class from Hilal hoca since, I believe, she is quite good at research. I have found the opportunity to read a plethora of papers and dissertations under the guidance of this course.
